correctness.rationale: For every real alpha and gamma, the exact mixed derivative equals positive \(C_y/x\) times \(L\). The proof globally minimizes \(L\) using \(k=x^{-\gamma}\) and \(w=x^\alpha(y^{-1}-1)\), treats \(\gamma<0\), \(\gamma=0\), \(\alpha\le0\), \(\gamma<\alpha\), all remaining \(\gamma\ge\alpha>0\), and proves every boundary by calculus, not sampled computations. The sufficient cases have the correct margins and nonnegative full-density; outside them a negative interior density gives a negative rectangle. Symbolic differentiation and high-precision checker independently match the formula; numerical tests are not asserted as infinite proofs.

originality.rationale: Proposition 7 of the original 2023 article proves only a sufficient parameter subregion for the exact Int2 formula. The new work proves necessity and sufficiency over all real alpha and gamma, extending negative alpha, \(\alpha>1\), and \(\gamma>1\); the \(H_\alpha\) boundary and terminal \(\alpha_{\rm c}\) are not implied by that sufficient result. Relevant indexed results considered different copula formulas. Full historical priority is not independently certified, especially for the inaccessible 2024 related source.

value.rationale: The old sufficient parameter box excludes many valid copulas. A complete necessary-and-sufficient domain for an established two-parameter dependence model permits mathematically defensible inference and simulation; it reveals an unexpected logarithmic terminal alpha cutoff, previously excluded negative shapes, a positive-shape region beyond one, and an exact boundary in the unrestricted real parameter plane. This supplies a motivated structural classification, not a textbook restatement or arbitrary isolated numerical slice.
